message.jaymoskingdoms.royal_remains.cal: Get to %s, before anyone else does!
I'll not leave %s lying out there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.royal_remains.str: The crown keeps your things safe now, %s.
No thief will have your armour, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.royal_remains.rit: Let the Truth take you in, %s, and keep you.
You kept this realm; now it keeps you, %s.
Go in peace, %s. Your watch is ended.
message.jaymoskingdoms.royal_remains.bur: Sleep, %s. The realm will keep a light for you.
Here lies %s, who ruled us. Rest now.
